slides.title: Radiation
text: Can be used alone or in combo with chemotherapy and/or surgery

Two types – external beam (teletherapy) and internal(brachytherapy)

slides.title: RadiationExternal Beam
text: Will be alone in treatment room, but communication devices are present

slides.title: RadiationExternal Beam
text: Permanent markers or with tattoos that look like tiny freckles
Do not cleanse area that is marked with ink
Avoid use of perfumed soaps, lotions or deodorant on involved skin area

Do not use heating pads, hot water bottles or ice packs to treated area
Avoid tight clothing over the treatment site
Avoid direct exposure to the sun
Use electric razor of shaving is necessary

slides.title: Which of the following clients should the nurse delegate the taking of vital signs for to the unlicensed assistive personnel (UAP)?
text: Which of the following clients should the nurse delegate the taking of vital signs for to the unlicensed assistive personnel (UAP)?
A client being prepared for elective facial surgery with a history of stable hypertension.
A client receiving a blood transfusion with a history of transfusion reactions.
A client recently started on a new antiarrhythmic agent.
A client who is admitted frequently with asthma attacks.

slides.title: A client being prepared for elective facial surgery with a history of stable hypertension. Yes, the client is stable.
text: A client being prepared for elective facial surgery with a history of stable hypertension. Yes, the client is stable.
A client receiving a blood transfusion with a history of transfusion reactions. No, this client is unstable.
A client recently started on a new antiarrhythmic agent. No, the UAP cannot take apical pulses.
A client who is admitted frequently with asthma attacks. No, this client is unstable and vital sign measurement should not be delegated.
